description: T14 fit-selection keybind (design doc §1). Shift+F zooms and centres the camera on the selected unit: the bounding box of all its alive models with their bases, centred in the part of the window the board can be seen in (the viewport minus the top bar HUD_Bottom, the PhaseStrip, the GameLogPanel and HUD_Right, the same area the F fit uses), with 5" (200 px) of table kept in view around it on the tighter axis and the zoom capped at 1.2x, so nearby units stay in frame and the selection is never cropped. Shift+F glides there like F: the unit's centre slides on a straight screen line into the middle while the zoom changes at an even rate. What is drawn is Main.view_offset / view_zoom (BoardRoot's transform); the Camera2D renders nothing (Main is a CanvasLayer) and is a mirror whose position ends on the box centre. Player path on shooting_phase (Shooting phase, Player 1's Orks): a real click on the Gretchin mob (22 models on 25mm bases, hugging the top edge) selects it as the shooter; the camera is panned to the opposite (bottom) edge at 0.3x (view and mirror), so the mob is off screen; then the real Shift and F keys go through the OS-event pipeline, held while the glide is sampled every frame. Tier A: last_camera_fit_action 'selection'; Camera2D.position within 10px of the unit's centroid, read as the centre of its bounding box computed here from the unit data (the Change frames the bounding box; the mean of the model positions sits 43px left of it for this left-heavy mob); pixel_diff before -> after > 8%. Tier B in numbers: the box centre drawn within 2px of the free area's middle (free area read from the HUD panels' own rects); every base drawn inside it; every other model within 5" of the mob drawn inside it (at least 10 of them), while the far side of the board is out of view. The glide passes at least 3 intermediate zooms, never moves away from the fit, keeps the mob on the straight line in and always closer, and the mirror follows. Shift+F again once framed moves nothing; the scripted fit_view_to_selection() lands on the same framing with no glide; an embarked unit (Kommandos) frames its Battlewagon. After a real Esc deselects the shooter, Shift+F moves nothing and claims no fit. Last, the mob is stretched into one line across the board (setup only) and clicked again: Shift+F zooms out to the free width / (line + 400 px), well under the cap, every base inside the free area and the line's ends exactly 5" clear of the log and the right panel. With its five right-hand models dead (setup only), Shift+F frames the 17 living ones.

steps.comment: A drawn-secondaries review (not under test) would hold the keyboard; close it if it is up.
The hot-seat handoff screen eats input; acknowledge it the way the player's [Enter] does.
No modal window owns the keyboard, so real key presses reach Main._input.

steps.script:
var b = KeybindingManager.get_binding("fit_view_selection")
return int(b.get("key", -1)) == KEY_F and b.get("shift", false) and not b.get("ctrl", true) and not b.get("alt", true) and not b.get("meta", false)
steps.comment: Shift+F is bound to Fit View to Selection.

steps.script: return KeybindingManager.find_conflict("fit_view_selection", KEY_F, true, false, false, false)
steps.comment: No other action shares Shift+F.

steps.script:
# 'Pan the camera to the opposite edge': the view looks at the middle of
# the bottom edge at 0.3x. Sets what is drawn (view_offset / view_zoom,
# BoardRoot's transform) AND the Camera2D mirror.
var m = tree.current_scene
var vp = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
var z0 = 0.3
m.view_zoom = z0
m.view_offset = Vector2(880, 2250) - vp / (2.0 * z0)
m.update_view_transform()
m.camera.position = Vector2(880, 2250)
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z0, z0)
m.set_meta("t14_z0", z0)
m.last_camera_fit_action = ""
return m.last_camera_fit_action

steps.comment: The pan is really drawn: the whole mob is off screen (BoardRoot's transform).

steps.comment: The fit zoomed in on the mob rather than out to everything: Battlewagon Alpha (far side) is out of view.
Glides: at least 3 sampled frames strictly between the start zoom (0.3) and the fit.
The zoom never moves away from the fit.
No swing: on this 4x zoom-in the unit slides in on a straight line and only ever gets closer to the middle (a fixed-anchor glide would first carry it about 6% further out).
The Camera2D mirror animates too.
Shift and F really were held down (Input) while those frames ran.
Start -> mid...
...mid -> end: in-between frames were drawn, not one cut.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
return abs(m.view_zoom - m.get_meta("t14_fit_zoom")) + m.view_offset.distance_to(m.get_meta("t14_fit_offset"))

# A scripted call (the roster strip, other scenarios' setup) lands on the same
# framing at once, with no glide.
var m = tree.current_scene
m.view_zoom = 1.5
m.view_offset = Vector2(900, 1700)
m.update_view_transform()
m.last_camera_fit_action = ""
if not m.fit_view_to_selection("U_GRETCHIN_A"):
	return 999.0
if m.is_camera_glide_active():
	return 998.0
if m.last_camera_fit_action != "selection":
	return 997.0
return abs(m.view_zoom - m.get_meta("t14_fit_zoom")) + m.view_offset.distance_to(m.get_meta("t14_fit_offset"))

var m = tree.current_scene
m.last_camera_fit_action = ""
var r = [m.fit_view_to_selection(""), m.fit_view_to_selection("NOPE"), m.last_camera_fit_action]
return str(r)
